title: Reconnecting with an Old Friend
paragraphs: After losing touch for nearly five years following a small misunderstanding neither of them fully remembered, Tariq unexpectedly ran into his old friend Bassam at a mutual acquaintance's wedding.
The initial conversation felt slightly awkward, both of them unsure whether to address the years of silence directly or simply continue as though nothing unusual had happened between them.
Eventually, Tariq mentioned honestly that he had missed their friendship, and Bassam admitted he had felt the same but never knew how to reach out after so much time had passed.
They exchanged numbers again that evening, and within a month, their friendship had resumed almost naturally, teaching both of them that pride had cost them years they could never get back.
